import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    print()

import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print("ARCHIVE CONTENTS:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print(" ", n)
    print("\nworkbook.xml:")
    print(z.read('xl/workbook.xml').decode('utf-8'))
    print("\nworkbook.xml.rels:")
    print(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels').decode('utf-8'))
